courthouses.name: Criminal Branch
courthouses.hours: Phones Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; counter Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Criminal Operations handles non-traffic infractions, misdemeanors and felonies. Court location page lists 1050 Monterey St Rm 220 as the clerk address for the Criminal Branch. Newly arrested people must be arraigned within 48 hours (Sheriff FAQ).

courthouses.name: Civil & Family Law Branch
courthouses.hours: Phones Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; counter Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.

courthouses.name: Grover Beach Branch
courthouses.hours: Phones Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; counter Mon–Thu 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.

courthouses.name: Paso Robles Branch
courthouses.hours: Phones Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.; counter Wednesday and Friday 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Case types heard here are not listed on the court's location page.

courthouses.name: Juvenile Services Center
courthouses.hours: Juvenile delinquency calendar Monday mornings at 8:00 a.m.; phones Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m.
courthouses.note: Juvenile justice (delinquency) hearings are held at 1065 Kansas Avenue; court lists 1050 Monterey Street as the clerk address. Probation lists zip 93401 for 1065 Kansas Ave.

public_defenders.name: San Luis Obispo Defenders (primary contract public defender)
public_defenders.address: 991 Osos St. Suite A (JP Andrews building, across from the courthouse)
public_defenders.note: SLO County has no county PD office; it contracts with three firms (primary, conflict, secondary conflict). County page lists SLO Defenders as primary. Conflict firms are not named on the county page.

legal_aid.name: San Luis Obispo Defenders — Expungements info
legal_aid.what: PD page: misdemeanor 1203.4 petitions can be filed yourself with court forms (CR-180/CR-181); for felonies, SLO requires a formal motion — contact the attorney who represented you. Includes an eligibility flow chart.

legal_aid.name: SLO Court — Cleaning Your Record self-help
legal_aid.what: Step-by-step table: petition for dismissal (PC 17(b), 1203.4, 1203.4a, 1203.41) for infractions/misdemeanors; early probation termination (PC 1203.3) plus 17(b) reduction plus 1203.4 dismissal for felonies; also pardons and certificates of rehabilitation.

probation.name: SLO Probation — Adult Services
probation.note: Fax (805) 781-1231. Payments: phone (805) 781-4060, online slo.epay-it.com, or mail.

programs.name: Clearing a warrant
programs.summary: Options: post bail (if a bail amount is set — at the court or any law enforcement agency), turn yourself in (to SLO County Jail or any CA agency), or calendar a court surrender. Have your name and case number or date of birth ready.

programs.name: Veterans Treatment Court
programs.summary: The court site links a 'Veterans' Treatment Video'. No program page with eligibility was found.

programs.name: Sheriff Alternative Sentencing
programs.summary: Sheriff's Jail Information section describes alternatives to serving time in the County Jail.

programs.name: Cite release / book & release
programs.summary: Sheriff FAQ: people meeting jail criteria are often cite-released on new misdemeanors with a promise to appear (no bail). Anyone arrested for being under the influence stays at least 4 hours. Cite releases after dark need a ride waiting.

programs.name: Ancillary defense services (self-represented)
programs.summary: Self-represented defendants can request reasonably necessary funds for their defense (ancillary services).

jails.name: San Luis Obispo County Jail — Men's Jail
jails.phone_note: On-site visits by appointment only through NCIC (videovisit.ncic.com), 7 days to 48 hours ahead; check in at least 45 minutes early; 2 one-hour on-site visits per week. Remote video visits also via NCIC ($0.19/min). Jail info line (805) 781-4600; Records (805) 781-4588.
jails.note: Sheriff FAQ gives one physical address for 'the jail' and separate visiting schedules for the men's jail, women's jail and Honor Farm.
jails.todo: court_ids: only criminal courthouse in county per court site; not confirmed by Sheriff

bail.note: SLO Sheriff FAQ: unless there is a hold or 'No Bail' status, bail may be posted at the jail for the full amount in U.S. currency, cashier's check, official bank/certified check, or USPS money order payable to San Luis Obispo County Sheriff's Office — no personal checks or credit cards. Bail info for someone in custody: (805) 781-4600. Verify any bail agent's license with the CA Department of Insurance.
